approval: NOT APPROVED. Proposed starting list of common descriptive terms for clinical review. The clinical lead and vocabulary maintainers must approve names, definitions and size conventions before a real annotation batch opens.
source: Drafted for the SuperDerm platform preview from widely used dermatologic descriptive terms.
notes: Size cut-offs (for example macule versus patch) vary between references and often cannot be measured in a photograph; the approved guide should say how to handle unknown size.

terms.name: Macule
terms.definition: Flat, non-palpable change in colour, small (commonly under 1 cm).

terms.name: Patch
terms.definition: Flat, non-palpable change in colour, larger (commonly 1 cm or more).

terms.name: Papule
terms.definition: Raised, palpable lesion, small (commonly under 1 cm).

terms.name: Plaque
terms.definition: Raised, plateau-like lesion, larger (commonly 1 cm or more).

terms.name: Nodule
terms.definition: Raised or deep, rounded lesion with depth, commonly 1 cm or more.

terms.name: Cyst
terms.definition: Enclosed cavity with liquid or semi-solid contents.

terms.name: Crust
terms.definition: Dried serum, blood or pus on the surface.

terms.name: Ulcer
terms.definition: Deeper loss of epidermis and dermis.

terms.name: Lichenification
terms.definition: Thickened skin with accentuated skin markings.

terms.name: Eschar or necrosis
terms.definition: Dead tissue, often black or dark crust adherent to the base.

terms.name: Purpura
terms.definition: Non-blanching discoloration from blood in the skin.

terms.name: Grouped or clustered
terms.definition: Lesions gathered together in a group.

terms.name: Umbilicated
terms.definition: Central depression in a raised lesion.
